description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeOnLeaveDao class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It tests retrieving lists of employees on leave and counting them based on date filters and access permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeOnLeaveDao, testing retrieval and counting of employee leave records based on date filters and access controls.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of EmployeeOnLeaveDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee leave list with various date filters and access permissions, verifying the correctness of the returned data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Tests counting of employee leave records with different filters, ensuring correct count values.
